posts.body:
BAY ESTATE — BROKER INTELLIGENCE
Nakheel | Island E, Dubai Islands

Current developer-manager and broker material points to 3–4BR townhouses and 4BR garden or standalone villas, with sales reportedly on 25 September after the planned 22 September briefing was cancelled.

Public broker pages currently quote approximately AED 4.7m–5.5m for a 3BR townhouse, but the figures conflict and no Nakheel price list has been verified. Payment plan, handover and final inventory remain unconfirmed.

Why it matters: this is the first reported residential release on Island E.
Confidence: medium-high on identity, location and product mix; medium on timing; commercial terms unconfirmed.

posts.materialUpdate: A developer-partner allocation briefing reviewed on 23 September clarifies the sequence behind Aldar's public 23 September sales commencement: non-resident allocations on 24 September and public launch on 25 September.
posts.body:
TALAY — ALLOCATION-TIMING UPDATE
Aldar | Marsa Al Saadiyat, Abu Dhabi

A developer-partner briefing clarifies Aldar's published 23 September sales commencement: non-resident allocations are indicated for 24 September and the public launch for 25 September.

The release comprises 351 standalone 4–6BR villas across Talay and Talay Beach. Broker material indicates Talay from AED 13.5m with 50/50 payments and Q4 2029 handover; Talay Beach is indicated for Q4 2030. These commercial terms remain unverified against final Aldar sales documents, and Talay Beach pricing is still unknown.

Why it matters: buyers now have a clearer allocation sequence for the first Marsa Al Saadiyat villa release.
Confidence: high on project and official sales commencement; medium-high on the 24/25 September allocation sequence; commercial terms remain indicative.
